::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 17th 1876  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS University of London Library/AL 293/2/1
:::

Dear Madam

I am much obliged for your gift of the ‘[Names on the Gates of Pearl](other_books/otherbook_874.qmd)’<sup>1</sup> -  I am already a great admirer of it, and introduced it to [Miss Mackenzie](people/person_930.qmd) (the sister of the late [Bishop of Zululand](people/person_929.qmd) and editor of the [Net](organizations/other_94.qmd), and she has sent it to some of her Missionary friends  I will do what more I can for I am sure it ought to be known.

yours truly
C M Yonge
